question: Which of the following temples is built in the style of the Rekha Deula or the one with a curvilinear superstructure?

options.text: Kandariya Mahadev Temple in Madhya Pradesh

solution:
The correct answer is __**Sri Jagannath Temple in Odisha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sri Jagannath Temple** in **Odisha** is built in the style of the **Rekha Deula** or the one with a curvilinear superstructure.
 
• The renowned Jagannath Puri Temple, situated in the Indian state of Odisha, stands as one of its most magnificent monuments.
